description: Cuts everything below one frequency and above another out of a signal, with an FFT rather than a filter

params.text: Sets the frequency below which the signal is cut, 0Hz to 12000Hz
Sets the frequency above which the signal is cut, 0Hz to 12000Hz; at the top of its travel no high cut is made at all

inputs.text: The signal to be cut, one per channel
Sets the low cut by voltage in place of the Low knob, 0-10V across 0Hz to 12000Hz
Sets the high cut by voltage in place of the Hi knob, 0-10V across 0Hz to 12000Hz

outputs.text: The signal with the frequencies outside the two settings removed

notes: the work is done on blocks of samples, so the output is behind the input by the FFT length set in the menu
menu: FFT Length — sets the block length the FFT works on, 1024, 2048 or 4096 samples; a longer block cuts more sharply and puts the output further behind the input

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Low knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Hi knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
